name: Chappa Auto
also_styled: Chappa Auto Parts Ltd (Facebook page name; not verified as the legal name)
type_detail: Auto parts, tyres, Shell lubricants and accessories: retailer and distributor (not a car dealership or workshop)
one_liner: Brake parts, tyres and Shell lubricants for everyday drivers, mechanics and business fleets, from branches across Jamaica.
about: Founded in 2003 by Ms. Hazel Tomlinson (official About page) to give drivers and mechanics in Savanna-la-Mar and surrounding areas access to reliable, high-quality automotive products. Began at Tanka Plaza, 60 Beckford Street, Savanna-la-Mar (About page spelling; Contact page prints Tanker Plaza / Savanna La Mar). Grown into a multi-branch operation; About says six locations across Westmoreland, St. James, Hanover and Kingston, but only five are published.
service_area: Branches in Kingston, St. James, Hanover and Westmoreland
